mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART ( quantity, cart_type, user_id, product_id, option_id, rental_start, rental_end, created_at ) VALUES ( #{quantity}, #{cartType}, #{userId}, #{productId}, NULLIF(#{optionId}, ''), NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, ''), NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, ''), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT cart_id AS cartId, quantity AS quantity FROM CART WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND cart_type = #{cartType} AND ( option_id = NULLIF(#{optionId}, '') OR (option_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(#{optionId}, '') IS NULL) )
AND rental_start = NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, '') AND rental_end = NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, '')
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.cart_type AS cartType, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.option_id AS optionId, c.rental_start AS rentalStart, c.rental_end AS rentalEnd, p.product_name AS productName, p.price AS price, b.brand_name AS brandName, i.img_url AS imgUrl, o.option_value AS optionName FROM CART c INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.product_id = i.product_id AND i.is_main = 'Y' LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION o ON c.option_id = o.option_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CART SET quantity = #{quantity}, option_id = NULLIF(#{optionId}, ''), rental_start = NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, ''), rental_end = NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, '') WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT cart_id AS cartId, quantity, cart_type AS cartType, product_id AS productId, option_id AS optionId, rental_start AS rentalStart, rental_end AS rentalEnd FROM CART WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND user_id = #{userId}
